The question is posed about its role within the band's timeline. "El primero es que papel juega el Tranquilitiba Houtel en casino último al bóndalo de los Artic Monkeys dentro de la línea temporal de los propios Artic Monkeys."

podcast.body: This recent album has caused extreme reactions within the music industry and among fans, leading to widespread disappointment and difficulty in assessing its quality. It represents a drastic stylistic change for the band, described by some as a "professional suicide," while others view it as a logical evolution if considering their other projects like The Last Shadow Puppets. The album's style, heavily influenced by Gainsbourg, Bowie, James Bond, and Kubrick films, moves between retro reinterpretation and a direct retro sound, sometimes bordering on "elevator music." Critics note it doesn't sound like a cohesive band effort, but rather like a solo project by Alex Turner, and that it loses some of the band's essential DNA, failing to maintain a core essence while reinventing. "Estabiendo reacciones muy extremas, está viendo como mucho opinión muy difícil de asumir, está viendo como un sentimiento de excepción muy generalizado en parte de la crítica y también en parte de los fans."
